title: Reliability and Generalization in UAV Crop-Weed Mapping: A Scoping Review
description: Provisional scoping review and AG screening pilot; development query calibration executed, formal search and accepted screening not executed.
research_questions: RQ1: How do UAV crop-weed mapping studies define and evaluate reliability under spectral degradation, sensor differences, and temporal shift?
RQ2: Which datasets, sensors, dates, fields, and split units support the reported generalization claims?
RQ3: How are uncertainty, calibration, missing evidence, and failed transfer reported?
RQ4: Which evidence gaps remain after separating dataset diversity, model mechanisms, and demonstrated external validation?
